Start from Amazon Reviews 2023
Purchase Records across 15 E-Commerce Categories
Use Implicit Preferences from Real Transactions

Construct Recommendation Contexts
Most Recent Purchase = Target Item
Title + Price + Merchant; Earlier Purchases = User History

Apply Dataset Quality Controls
Title ≥ 6 Alphabetic Characters • Users with 5–20 Purchases
Keep 5-Star Purchases • Cap Each Category at 200 Behaviors

Retain the ALERT Dataset
2,761 User–Item Interactions in 15 Categories
Purchase-History Profiles; No Demographics or User IDs

Develop 4 Evaluation Criteria
E-Commerce Editorial Team + User-Study Refinement
Reasoning • Clear / Concise • Engaging • Neutral Tone

Form a Pairwise Explanation Comparison
Candidate Model vs PreferenceLogic Baseline
Provide User History, Target Item, and One Criterion

ALERT-Gen
Claude-3-Sonnet Chain-of-Thought Comparison
Output A / B / C (Tie); Systematically Swap Positions

ALERT-Disc
ArmoRM Scores Both Explanations
Higher Criterion-Specific Reward Wins

Divide by Evaluation Criterion
Judge Reasoning, Clarity, Narrative, and Tone Separately
Obtain Four Focused Preferences

Aggregate by Majority Vote
Combine the Four Criterion Preferences
Produce the Final A / B / Tie Judgment

ALERT Benchmark Result
Win Rate = % Interactions Where Candidate Beats Baseline
Report ALERT-Gen and ALERT-Disc Comparisons

Meta-Evaluate Evaluator Reliability
Controlled Data / Prompt Interruptions + 3 Expert Annotators
About 70% Concordance with Expert Human Judgment
